video:video.video:title: Jesus' Betrayal and Arrest: A Divine Plan Unfolds
video:video.video:description: Jesus willingly faced betrayal and arrest as part of God's plan for salvation. His submission to God's will overcame evil intentions, leading to victory over Satan's accusations. Through Jesus' sacrifice on the cross, believers find freedom from condemnation and assurance of eternal life.

video:video.video:title: Jesus' Crucifixion: A Call to Repentance and Faith
video:video.video:description: Jesus, carrying the cross, urges women to weep for themselves. He forewarns of Jerusalem's doom for rejecting Him. Repent and trust in Jesus for forgiveness and peace with God.

video:video.video:title: Discovering Hidden Treasures of Wisdom in Christ
video:video.video:description: Exploring Solomon's choice for wisdom over riches, we learn the value of seeking true wisdom in Christ. Just as Solomon prioritised wisdom from God, we are urged to seek the treasures of wisdom and understanding found only in Jesus. Through prayer, Bible study, and serving Christ, we align our priorities with God's, gaining insight and knowledge that surpasses earthly wealth. Let us diligently pursue the hidden treasures of wisdom in Christ, embracing His forgiveness and restoring our relationship with our loving Saviour.

video:video.video:title: The Innocence of Jesus and His Sacrificial Redemption
video:video.video:description: Jesus, innocent and sinless, faced false accusations yet Pilate acknowledged his blamelessness. Despite attempts to defer, bargain, and please the crowd, Pilate yielded to crucify Jesus. His sacrifice redeemed us, offering freedom from sin's grip and purpose in life through his precious blood.

video:video.video:title: God's Faithfulness to Jacob and Israel
video:video.video:description: God fulfils promises to Jacob, prospering him and his descendants. Jacob's story mirrors Israel's future exodus from Egypt. Ultimately, Jesus brings greater salvation, securing blessings for us.

video:video.video:title: Jesus' Sacrificial Love and Forgiveness
video:video.video:description: Jesus exemplifies sacrificial love by praying for enemies, staying on the cross for sinners, and granting paradise to a repentant criminal. His actions reveal God's heart for forgiveness and redemption, inviting us to repent, seek grace, and experience eternal life through faith in Him.

image:image.image:title: God's Faithfulness in Jacob's Journey

video:video.video:title: God's Faithfulness in Jacob's Journey
video:video.video:description: Jacob's story in Genesis 31 reveals God's faithfulness amid challenges. Laban's changing attitude, God's guidance, and Jacob's family dynamics reflect God's providence. Despite conflicts and accusations, God intervenes, protecting Jacob and ensuring peace. This narrative echoes God's care for us, guiding us through life's complexities and conflicts. Just as Jacob trusted God's plan, we can rely on God's faithfulness in our own journeys, knowing that He works for our ultimate good, even in the midst of trials.

image:image.image:caption: Listen to 'The Uniqueness of Jesus' Death on the Cross' by Mark Drury preached on October 12, 2025 - Luke 23:44-49. Jesus' death on the cross was unique -...
image:image.image:title: The Uniqueness of Jesus' Death on the Cross

video:video.video:title: The Uniqueness of Jesus' Death on the Cross
video:video.video:description: Jesus' death on the cross was unique - darkness symbolised God's judgment, the torn temple curtain signified access to God, and Jesus' final words showed victory over death. The Roman centurion recognised Jesus' righteousness, bystanders felt guilt, and close followers stood in sorrow. We too can confidently entrust ourselves to God, knowing Jesus' death secured forgiveness and eternal life. Reflect on your response to Jesus' sacrifice - it opens the way to God's presence and eternal fellowship. May we embrace the power of the cross and live in the victory of Christ's resurrection.

image:image.image:caption: Listen to 'God's Relentless Grace: Encountering Angels in Times of Anxiety' by Mark Drury preached on October 12, 2025 - Genesis 32:1. In Genesis 32:1, Jac...
image:image.image:title: God's Relentless Grace: Encountering Angels in Times of Anxiety

video:video.video:title: God's Relentless Grace: Encountering Angels in Times of Anxiety
video:video.video:description: In Genesis 32:1, Jacob, anxious about facing Esau, encounters angels. Like Jacob, we too experience God's relentless grace through angelic protection and reassurance in times of fear. Just as God cared for Jacob, He watches over us, guarding our souls with His love. Let's trust in God's unfailing grace to guide us through anxious moments, knowing He is with us always.

image:image.image:caption: Listen to 'The Importance of Jesus' Death and Burial' by Mark Drury preached on October 19, 2025 - Luke 23:50-56 (Part of the Malachi series). Jesus' buria...
image:image.image:title: The Importance of Jesus' Death and Burial

video:video.video:title: The Importance of Jesus' Death and Burial
video:video.video:description: Jesus' burial confirms His death for our sins, crucial for our redemption. Witnesses testify to His death and burial, securing our salvation. The burial of Jesus is not just a historical fact but a vital part of the gospel message, assuring us of His sacrifice and victory over sin and death.

image:image.image:caption: Listen to 'The New Creation: Jesus' Resurrection and Our Hope' by Guest speaker preached on October 26, 2025 - Luke 24:1-12. Jesus' resurrection was a real...
image:image.image:title: The New Creation: Jesus' Resurrection and Our Hope

video:video.video:title: The New Creation: Jesus' Resurrection and Our Hope
video:video.video:description: Jesus' resurrection was a real, necessary, and new event, revealing eternal life. We are born anew in Christ, anticipating the fullness of the new creation when He returns. Our hope rests in the victory of Christ over death, offering us eternal life and reconciliation with God.

image:image.image:caption: Listen to 'Peace with God through Faith in Jesus' by Mark Drury preached on November 9, 2025 - Romans 5:1 (Part of the Romans series). Through faith in Jes...
image:image.image:title: Peace with God through Faith in Jesus

video:video.video:title: Peace with God through Faith in Jesus
video:video.video:description: Through faith in Jesus, we find peace with God, being justified and reconciled. This peace brings assurance of no condemnation, fellowship with God, and a transcendent calm. Just as peace between nations is valued, peace with God is infinitely greater, offering eternal security and divine communion. The cost of peace with God was met by Jesus on the cross, satisfying God's justice and granting forgiveness and righteousness to all who believe. Embrace this peace today and enjoy the unshakable relationship with God it brings.

image:image.image:caption: Listen to 'The glorious mystery of the Church' by Ollie Land preached on November 16, 2025 - Ephesians 3:1-13 (Part of the Visiting speaker series). God's...
image:image.image:title: The glorious mystery of the Church

video:video.video:title: The glorious mystery of the Church
video:video.video:description: God's eternal plan unfolds as the church reveals the mystery of unity in Christ for all nations through the gospel. We are privileged to be part of this glorious purpose, displaying God's wisdom and grace to the world and even to the heavenly places. By committing to the local church, we actively participate in God's grand design, uniting all things in Jesus for His glory. Let us embrace this calling with joy and dedication, knowing that every believer's story contributes to the praise of God's glorious grace.

image:image.image:title: Partial Obedience vs Full Obedience in Jacob's Life

video:video.video:title: Partial Obedience vs Full Obedience in Jacob's Life
video:video.video:description: Jacob's journey reveals our struggle with partial obedience to God's call. Despite growth, we often fall short, like Jacob's lies and misplaced altar. God's sanctifying work in us progresses towards full obedience, striving for holiness until glorification.

image:image.image:caption: Listen to 'The Risen Hope: Encountering Jesus on the Road to Emmaus' by Mark Drury preached on November 2, 2025 - Luke 24:13-35. Encounter the journey of t...
image:image.image:title: The Risen Hope: Encountering Jesus on the Road to Emmaus

video:video.video:title: The Risen Hope: Encountering Jesus on the Road to Emmaus
video:video.video:description: Encounter the journey of two dejected disciples on the road to Emmaus, their hope shattered by Jesus' death. Witness Jesus' rebuke for lack of faith in Scriptures, followed by profound instruction revealing Old Testament prophecies of Himself. Experience the elation as recognition of Jesus restores hope and joy, leading to a deep understanding of the resurrection's significance. The risen Christ brings new life, assures justification, and promises future resurrection, offering a living hope that transforms our present and secures our eternal future.

image:image.image:caption: Listen to 'Jacob's Reconciliation with Esau: A Story of Grace' by Mark Drury preached on November 9, 2025 - Genesis 33:1-11 (Part of the Genesis series). J...
image:image.image:title: Jacob's Reconciliation with Esau: A Story of Grace

video:video.video:title: Jacob's Reconciliation with Esau: A Story of Grace
video:video.video:description: Jacob, fearing trouble, finds unexpected grace as Esau forgives him. Through prayer and seeking God's blessing, Jacob experiences reconciliation and acceptance. Like Jacob, we should trust God in difficulties, casting our cares on Him, for He cares for us.

image:image.image:caption: Listen to 'The Peace Christ Offers: Beyond Worldly Comfort' by Ralph Spencer preached on November 23, 2025 - Philippians 4:4-7. Discover the peace Christ o...
image:image.image:title: The Peace Christ Offers: Beyond Worldly Comfort

video:video.video:title: The Peace Christ Offers: Beyond Worldly Comfort
video:video.video:description: Discover the peace Christ offers, surpassing worldly comforts. Rejoice, show gentleness, and trust in God's presence and promises for enduring peace in all circumstances. Through prayer, supplication, and thanksgiving, experience the peace that transcends understanding, guarding our hearts and minds. Embrace Christ's peace, not as an escape, but as strength, hope, and love in tribulations. Seek peace that endures, rooted in Christ's sacrifice, not temporary fixes the world provides. Let us find true peace in Christ, facing life's challenges with unwavering trust and joy.

image:image.image:caption: Listen to 'Witnesses of Jesus' Resurrection: A Call to Every Believer' by Mark Drury preached on November 23, 2025 - Luke 24:36-49. We are called to be wit...
image:image.image:title: Witnesses of Jesus' Resurrection: A Call to Every Believer

video:video.video:title: Witnesses of Jesus' Resurrection: A Call to Every Believer
video:video.video:description: We are called to be witnesses of Jesus' resurrection, sharing the Old Testament's prophecies of his death and resurrection. Our testimony includes the forgiveness of sins proclaimed to all nations. Through the Holy Spirit's empowerment, like the disciples on Pentecost, we can boldly share the saving grace of the Lord Jesus. Let's renew our commitment to witness, starting in our local community and extending to the ends of the earth. As Christ's witnesses, we have a vital role in spreading the gospel and building His church.
